support.title: How can we help?
support.faq1Answer: On the <link>Sign in</link> page, you can request a password reset email under "Forgot password?".
support.faq2Question: How do I add a team or a game?
support.faq2Answer: As a club admin, you'll find this under "Teams" or "Games" in your club dashboard.
support.faq3Question: I have a question about my subscription/billing.
support.faq3Answer: As a club admin, you can view and manage your subscription directly in the dashboard under "Manage subscription" (handled via Stripe). For anything else, reach out to us directly.
support.faq4Answer: Tell us briefly what happened — ideally with your club/team, browser, and the steps that led to the bug.
